title: Game of Divisibility
source_topic: ICPC / The 2017 ACM - Asia Ho Chi Minh City Regional Contest
statement: Two players alternately remove one number from a list of up to 1024 integers until it is empty, the first player starting, and each scores the sum of what he took. A player wins only if his own score is divisible by k while his opponent's is not; otherwise the game is drawn. Across datasets with k at most 32, report the result under optimal play.
